debate.key_bull_argument: Golden cross + MACD bullish crossover + stochastic bullish cross create strong technical confluence in extreme fear environment (VIX 390+), offering contrarian entry near support at 42.75.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro environment is severely unfavourable (negative score -4, crisis VIX, rising dollar, high credit spreads), ADX trend strength is weak (23.22), Williams %R overbought signals pullback risk, and no formal strategy trigger confirms entry—technical signals lack conviction in hostile conditions.
